ZagaraMasteryVolatileAcid.name: Volatile Acid
ZagaraMasteryVolatileAcid.description: Banelings can travel 50% further before exploding.

ZagaraMasteryCorpseFeeders.name: Corpse Feeders
ZagaraMasteryCorpseFeeders.description: Reduces the cooldown of Infested Drop by 3 seconds and Roachlings have 30% more Health.

ZagaraMasteryInfest.name: Infest
ZagaraMasteryInfest.description: Nearby Ranged Minions deal an additional 100% damage. Can be toggled on or off. Repeatable Quest: Every 1000 Siege damage dealt increases this bonus by 1%.

ZagaraMasteryEnvenomedSpines.name: Envenomed Spines
ZagaraMasteryEnvenomedSpines.description: Activate to have Zagara's next Basic Attack apply 230 damage over 5 seconds.

ZagaraCombatStyleMedusaBlades.name: Medusa Blades
ZagaraCombatStyleMedusaBlades.description: Basic Attacks deal 33% damage to three nearby targets.

ZagaraMasterySerratedSpines.name: Serrated Spines
ZagaraMasterySerratedSpines.description: Quest: Each Basic Attack against a Hero increases Zagara's Attack Damage by 0.2%.

ZagaraMasteryBanelingMassacre.name: Baneling Massacre
ZagaraMasteryBanelingMassacre.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Banelings Barrage, but increase its cooldown by 2 seconds.

ZagaraViscousAcid.name: Viscous Acid
ZagaraViscousAcid.description: Banelings Slow enemies by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

ZagaraMasteryBileDrop.name: Bile Drop
ZagaraMasteryBileDrop.description: Quest: Passively increases the radius of Infested Drop by 20%. Reward: After hitting 12 Heroes with Infested Drop, it spawns an additional Roachling.

ZagaraHeroicAbilityDevouringMaw.name: Devouring Maw
ZagaraHeroicAbilityDevouringMaw.description: Summon a Devouring Maw that devours enemies for 4 seconds. Devoured enemies cannot fight and take 94 damage per second. Usable on Unstoppable enemies.

ZagaraHeroicAbilityNydusAssault.name: Nydus Network
ZagaraHeroicAbilityNydusAssault.description: Summon a Nydus Worm on Creep anywhere that Zagara has vision. Zagara can enter a Nydus Worm and travel to any other Nydus Worm by right-clicking near it. While inside a Nydus Worm, Zagara regenerates 10% Health and Mana per second. Stores up to 2 charges. Maximum of 4 Nydus Worms

ZagaraMasteryHydraliskTransfusion.name: Hydralisk Transfusion
ZagaraMasteryHydraliskTransfusion.description: Zagara is healed for 60% of the damage dealt by Hunter Killers' Basic Attacks to Heroes.

ZagaraMasteryProtectiveCoating.name: Protective Coating
ZagaraMasteryProtectiveCoating.description: While on Creep, Zagara gains 20 Armor, taking 20% less damage.

GenericTalentSpellShield.name: Spell Shield
GenericTalentSpellShield.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%. Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

ZagaraMasteryCorrosiveSaliva.name: Corrosive Saliva
ZagaraMasteryCorrosiveSaliva.description: When attacking Heroes, Hunter Killers and Roachlings deal additional damage equal to 1.5% of their maximum Health.

ZagaraMasteryMutalisk.name: Mutalisk
ZagaraMasteryMutalisk.description: Reduce the cooldown of Hunter Killer by 4 seconds. Hunter Killer now spawns a Mutalisk. Mutalisks have a bounce attack, lose Health over 42 seconds, and have 450 Health.

ZagaraJaggedBarbsTalent.name: Jagged Barbs
ZagaraJaggedBarbsTalent.description: While on Creep, Zagara gains 50% more Basic Attack damage and her attack range is increased by 1.1.

ZagaraMasteryTyrantMaw.name: Tyrant Maw
ZagaraMasteryTyrantMaw.description: Devouring Maw deals 50% more damage. Takedowns reduce its cooldown by 25 seconds.

ZagaraMasteryEndlessCreep.name: Endless Creep
ZagaraMasteryEndlessCreep.description: Increase Creep Tumor's cast range from 2.5 to 50. Creep Tumors now last 600 seconds. While on Creep, Zagara gains an additional 10% Movement Speed.

ZagaraBroodmother.name: Broodmother
ZagaraBroodmother.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack also launches a Baneling towards the target. Passive: Gain 20% bonus Attack Speed.

ZagaraPackInstinct.name: Pack Instinct
ZagaraPackInstinct.description: Zagara and her summons deal 20% more damage to enemies attacked by a Hunter Killer in the last 2 seconds.
